svg.title: Client and guest access: how the pieces fit — SoftTrack web design mockup (#234)
svg.desc: A client reaches SoftTrack either through an account marked as outside the organisation, which sees the epics it was given and may comment where the team allows, or through a share link that needs no account. Neither reaches the directory, departments, workload, team creation or expense claims.
svg.text: Client and guest access: how the pieces fit
· outside people, given exactly what they need

g.text: two ways in, and what neither reaches
Invited by a team admin, and marked as outside the organisation when it is.
Set on the invitation. Never by the person.
Tickets outside them do not exist for it.
A team setting. Off until a team turns it on.
Whoever has the link, and nothing to sign in to.
For one epic or one saved view. Expires, and is revoked
from the list that made it.
Key, title, status and progress. Comments and people only

svg.text: A guest from a neighbouring team keeps what it has today. What changes is for an account that is marked as outside.
at any point: it is one setting
in parallel: it needs no account
Principles: filtered in the query, never in the browser; a sweep test per boundary, the way tests/test_guest_role.py sends every write as a guest; members can always tell who is
reading; nothing here touches money. Each piece has its own mockup on its issue: #243, #244, #245 and #317.
